critical_evidence.evidence: There are no service records, oil-change dates or brake-fluid flush evidence. On a 10-year-old car at 32k miles, time-based service is the most likely gap.
This is a 2016 6MT, the build year most exposed to synchro and gearbox failures. There is no door-jamb build-date photo and no record of a warranty transmission replacement.
No footwell, carpet-lifted or drain-area photos were examined here. The top is shown folded only.

The VIN lookup lists 24V695000 (airbag control module software, 2016-2023) and 19V496000 (2016 skid plate/bracket detaching), and closure status is not shown for either. 19V072000 covers automatic TCM programming only and does not apply to this manual car.
No new-tire or new-battery claims are made. Tire DOT codes are not readable in the photos. The battery appears to be a replacement unit with no visible date.

documentation.rationale: The identity and terms half is present: VIN with a matching decode, a fully itemised price ($20,875 + $70 doc + $50 smog), and a Carfax 1-owner / no-damage summary. The maintenance half is absent: no receipts, no build-date photo, no recall printout and no tire dates.

condition.rationale: No fault is stated. The photos show straight panels, a clean stock engine bay and a matching set of Continental tires. They also show a torn section of the hood insulation pad, surface-corroded front rotor edges and oxidation spotting on the wheel spokes, which suggest the car has sat. The underside, interior and top fabric are not examined here.

price_value.rationale: At $20,995 all-in dealer price, the car sits about 4-5% above the $20,081 fair-value mid and inside the $18,316-$22,303 band. A base-trim, early-2016 6MT with no records argues for the lower half of that band.

mission_fit.rationale: This is a manual, light, reliable roadster that resells easily within 6-24 months, and its price is under the $27,000 ceiling, though slightly above the $19,000 ideal top. Early-2016 gearbox risk and missing time-based service keep the fit from being decisive.

logistics.rationale: Garden Grove, CA is about 330 miles from Carmel and the car is with a CA dealer. A smog certificate appears to be included and it is an easy fly-and-drive. Whether an independent PPI is allowed is not yet stated.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: The manual gearbox and a Soul Red-type colour are desirable. However, it is the base Sport trim with a CD head unit and no Club/BBS/Brembo equipment, which makes it a typical early ND.

ppi_focus: Warm-engine road test of the 6MT: grinding or popping out of 2nd/3rd, synchro crunch on fast shifts, plus a check of the door-jamb build date
Clutch slip in 4th-6th under load, engagement height and pedal squeak
Underhood wiring and harness check for rodent damage, given the torn hood insulation pad
Front and rear rotor and pad thickness, caliper slide function and the condition of the rust crust on the rotors
Soft top: fabric wear at the rear corners and header, drain function behind the seats, and damp carpet underlay or corroded seat-rail bolts
Water pump weep hole, valve cover, front crank seal and rear diff pinion/output seals
Skid plate and bracket security (recall 19V496000), and VIN recall closure for 24V695000
Tire DOT dates and battery load test
OBD scan for stored codes and readiness monitors
Brake fluid moisture test and alignment readings
what_would_change_verdict: Up: a door-jamb build date and records showing a gearbox replacement or no gearbox issues, plus a clean warm-shift PPI.
Up: dated service records including a brake fluid flush, a recall closure printout, and tires dated within roughly five years.
Up: a price negotiation toward the fair-value mid or below.
Down: grinding or popping out of gear, evidence of rodent wiring damage, damp carpets or a worn-through top at PPI.
Down: the full Carfax revealing title, ownership or accident issues the summary does not show.
evidence.mission_note: It fits the enthusiast-bridge brief as a manual, reliable, easily resold roadster priced under the $27,000 ceiling. The early-2016 gearbox and missing time-based service are the questions that decide whether it is a sound bridge or just a pretty one.
evidence.rationale: The VIN decode confirms a 2016 MX-5 Sport soft top with the 2.0L engine, and the listing states a 6-speed manual, 31,993 miles, and a Carfax summary of one owner with no reported damage. The price is fully itemised at $20,995 including $120 in dealer fees, slightly above the $20,081 fair-value mid. Photos show a clean, stock engine bay and straight panels. They also show a torn hood insulation pad, corroded front rotor edges and oxidised wheel spokes, which point to sitting and possible rodent intrusion. None of the five model-critical items is evidenced: no time-based service records, no build-date photo or transmission history for this most-exposed 2016 6MT year, no cabin water evidence, no recall closure for the applicable airbag and skid-plate campaigns, and no tire or battery dates. The automatic-transmission TCM recall does not apply to this manual car. No contradictions were found between the listing and the VIN decode.
evidence.next_action: Email Atlas Auto Mall for the full Carfax, a door-jamb build-date photo, the tire DOT codes, a recall printout and an explanation of the torn hood pad, and confirm they will allow an independent PPI near Garden Grove before any deposit.
